intent.logline_zh: 清晨跑者穿出隧道奔向光明，单次摇镜揭示跑道。

characters.desc_zh: 20岁左右女性跑者，灰色背心，全程不说话

invariants.setting_zh: 清晨混凝土隧道与户外跑道

beats.what_zh: 跑者冲出隧道，固定广角
切户外跑道，单次右摇揭示空跑道

risks: 原文环绕推近拉远跟拍全要，已砍到只剩固定+单次右摇：单镜单运镜，否则必随机切镜

pe.integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action concrete tunnel interior at dawn, bright daylight glowing at the exit. A female runner in her 20s in a grey singlet sprints toward the light as the camera holds a static wide shot. [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to the open track outside and pans right once at slow speed to reveal the empty lanes ahead as she runs on.
pe.overall_soundscape: Echoing footsteps swelling in the tunnel, then wind and birdsong outside.
